notes.title: New Update Live!
notes.content:
Just in time for our Easter Sale you guys get a new update.

First of all, you guys can see some of the new materials we have been working on. With the next updates, more and more of theese will be added (Y).

If you find some of our hidden easterbaskets, please let us know and post a screenshot on the forum or on our facebook page. Let's see what happens if you find the most untill the easter sale ends on the second of april.


Have a nice day and enjoy this update,
Your CITY BALLS VR team
